corpus.format: mp3 (spotdown.org rips, ID3 tagged 4/4 frames: TIT2 TPE1 TALB APIC)
corpus.note: same folder the sibling audio-dna and taxonomy lanes mined; pairs identified from filenames + taxonomy.check.txt tag rows

method.recipe: same ffmpeg+numpy recipe as lanes/audio_dna_scan.py: ffmpeg decode to 8000 Hz mono s16le piped to numpy; rms_dbfs, crest_db, zcr_hz, welch low_ratio (20-150 Hz over 20-4000 Hz, hann 2048), onset-envelope autocorrelation BPM 60-180 with parabolic interpolation and acf-peak/lag0 confidence
method.delta_vs_sibling: pairs are decoded FULL LENGTH (audio-dna sampled first 90s) because the ask says sample the pairs fully; added band ratios (150-500, 500-2k, 2k-4k), dyn_range_db (p10-p90 of 250ms frame RMS), onset_rate (chop proxy)

rows.claim: Cross-artist remixes rewrite song form (duration delta median +15.6%, range -50.2% to +121.5%) while self-versions stay within 2.5%: duration delta is the cheapest remix-versus-remaster discriminator.
rows.steal: Add a duration-ratio floor check (under 3% delta = version, not transformation) to any corpus ingest that accepts remix-labeled audio, landing beside the catalog_audio registers.
rows.falsifier: A canon of cross-artist remixes whose durations all sit within 3% of their originals.

rows.claim: High-band energy ratio rises in 8 of 8 transformation pairs (median +33.9%, min +17.2%) while both self-versions sit at 0.0% and -10.0%: every remixer adds top end, reissues do not.
rows.steal: Use a high-band-ratio prior when classifying unlabeled remix files in state/fuel corpora (bpm_pcm holds 52 more wavs to re-classify).
rows.falsifier: A cross-artist remix whose high_ratio and zcr are both at or below its original's.

rows.claim: Median dyn delta hides a bimodal split: wall-school remixes compress (Sebastian -12.09 dB, Justice -3.53 dB) and shape-school remixes restore (Soulwax +13.68 dB, Classixx +8.2 dB); on the same source the two schools differ by 14.14 dB.
rows.steal: When grading generated covers or remixes, require the dynamics operator (compress or shape) to be named and matched to the claimed school, not just a sounds-different verdict.
rows.falsifier: A remix population where dyn_delta clusters unimodally around 0.

rows.claim: MSTRKRFT's D.A.N.C.E. remix is the band-swap signature: low +73.8%, mid -57.0%, high +49.6% - it removes the original's mid band and pays in sub and sizzle.
rows.steal: Port band-swap deltas as the fingerprint test for the 9 orphan remixes in state/fuel/bpm_pcm (one sitting, same recipe).
rows.falsifier: An electro-school remix that raises mid_ratio while cutting low_ratio.

rows.claim: Justice's NY Excuse remix leaves structure untouched (duration +2.6%, folded bpm 1.004) and re-voices it: zcr +54.0%, high +70.1%, low -38.1%, dyn -3.53 dB - distortion replaces bass.
rows.steal: Treat a zcr spike with flat form as the distortion fingerprint in the fleet's audio-similarity checks (dashboard/static/suno toys).
rows.falsifier: A Justice-attributed remix with increased dynamic range and unchanged zcr.

rows.claim: The Sebastian cut halves form (-50.2%), nearly doubles onset density (+49.9%), adds +3.02 dB and crushes 12.09 dB of dynamics: the chop is trigger multiplication plus form deletion, not re-harmonization.
rows.steal: Reuse the onset_rate function from lanes/remix_scan.py whenever an edit or remix claim needs a trigger-density diff.
rows.falsifier: A chop-attributed remix with onset density at or below its source.

rows.claim: Folded bpm ratio stays inside 0.847-1.326 across all 10 pairs (cross-artist median 1.07): tempo is the one invariant remixers do not spend; raw half-time reads are octave artifacts.
rows.steal: Use folded-tempo-near-1.0 as the pairing key when auto-detecting original/remix pairs in any music corpus (a cheap join predicate for catalog_audio).
rows.falsifier: A remix canon with folded bpm ratios scattered beyond 1.5x of unity.

rows.claim: Self-versions move only length and loudness (Flat Beat -2.5% dur and +0.13 dB, Rez -0.25% dur and +0.3 dB, bands within 10%), and the dup_suspect triple fired on zero rows: below this floor a remix claim is a reissue or a re-rip.
rows.steal: Adopt the dup_suspect triple (dur within 1.5s AND rms within 0.7 dB AND zcr within 3%) as the duplicate-audio detector for estate audio corpora.
rows.falsifier: A remaster that moves any spectral band ratio by more than 25%.

rows.claim: RMS deltas below roughly 4 dB are not attributable to arrangement at this instrument: the Animal pair's +12.8 dB is proven mastering/rip confound because the original rip peaks at -11.17 dBFS.
rows.steal: Before quoting any energy delta, check peak_dbfs of the quieter side: a peak far below 0 dBFS marks a quiet rip, not a quiet song.
rows.falsifier: A pair where a +12 dB-class energy delta survives on rips whose peaks both sit at 0 dBFS.

rows.claim: The only invariant across all 10 pairs is folded tempo near unity; form, energy, dynamics, spectrum and onset density are operator-controlled, so a faithful replica of transformed art is typed by its delta operator, not by similarity to the source.
rows.steal: When the estate replicates prior-wave artifacts (cards, protocols), diff against the source and bank the operator list; never bank byte-similarity as the fidelity metric.
rows.falsifier: A canon where remixes match originals on all measured deltas while still sounding like remixes.

checks.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe - (byte-check all 10 row quotes against cited source files) > remix-mechanics.quotes.txt 2>&1
